answer: Each identity locks a reserve before its claim counts, and that reserve is fully slashed if the claim is proven copied. A thousand fake voices thus need a thousand locked stakes, and each abandoned key burns its reserve instead of recycling. The protocol sets the minimum reserve above the marginal reward of one vote, so buying a majority costs more than winning it. Honest agents reclaim stakes at settlement, so one participant pays little while a coordinated fleet is ruinous. A desert oasis of honest nodes stays liquid, a juniper grove of clones dries up, and every extra vine pays that toll.
